methods.summary: Bounces the project to an audio file (File > Bounce > Project or Section): everything the app plays, through a second engine that has no sound card, faster than it plays. Audio regions, instruments, Aux strips and sends, effects, automation, tempo changes and the Stereo Out are in it; Mute and Solo are as in the app. Without a range: the cycle range while Cycle is on, else from bar 1 to the end of the last region. With `stems`, every track that is heard is also written to a file of its own beside the mix ("<mix> - 03 <track>.wav"), each from the same start and through the Stereo Out. `not_rendered` lists what should be in the file and is not, with the reason; `complete` says there is none. The call is answered when the bounce ends: pass `--timeout 0` to prowavectl for a long song.

methods.summary: Plays a stretch of the song into a WAV file of 32-bit floats, without the speakers, for measuring what was made. It is the app's bounce (see export.bounce) with a fixed tail: audio regions, instruments, effects, sends, automation and the Stereo Out are in it. Without a range it runs from bar 1 to the end of the last region. The call is answered when the file is written.
